killedBy: renderControllerSelfTest: structure states what Tanks will do with the pad, beside what the browser reported (issue #596)
why: Builds the verdict element and never appends it, which is the specific way a rendered line dies without anything throwing: the text is computed, the node exists, and no eye ever sees it. The row falls back to what it showed before issue #596 -- a mapping string and two counts -- leaving a tester to infer from an axis count whether the game accepted the device, which is the inference the verdict exists to remove.
